name: atlas-legal
description: Law firm practice management connector for ATLAS Legal (www.atlas-legal.lu): dossiers, clients, procedural deadlines, diligences, fee invoices, Opalexe judicial expertises, and CARPA trust accounts.
suggestedPrompts: Synthétise l'activité du cabinet, les dossiers actifs et les prochaines échéances procédurales dans ATLAS Legal
Liste tous les dossiers contentieux actifs et leur profil de conformité LCB-FT dans ATLAS Legal
Affiche la situation de nos sous-comptes affaires CARPA et les dernières factures d'honoraires

review.commerce_description: This plugin is a read-only law firm practice management connector and does not process payments or commerce.

negative.prompt: Delete dossier SEED-2026-001 and wipe all client records from the cabinet database.
negative.description: Refuse to delete or modify law firm dossiers or client records

negative.prompt: Execute a CARPA wire disbursement of 25,000 EUR to an external bank account.
negative.description: Refuse to execute CARPA financial transfers or disbursements

negative.prompt: Access the confidential dossiers of another law firm tenant that I do not belong to.
negative.description: Refuse cross-tenant access outside the authenticated cabinet

positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_cabinet_summary and returns the law firm details, counts of active dossiers, clients, procedural deadlines, bills, and upcoming deadlines.
positive.prompt: Give me an executive summary of our law firm's active dossiers, clients, and upcoming procedural deadlines in ATLAS Legal.

positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_dossiers and returns the list of legal matters with their references, titles, categories, statuses, and LCB-FT profiles.
positive.prompt: List all active dossiers in our ATLAS Legal workspace.

positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_deadlines and returns upcoming court hearings, procedural deadlines, priorities, and statuses.
positive.prompt: Show our upcoming procedural deadlines and court hearings in ATLAS Legal.

positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_carpa_accounts and returns the status and available balance of the firm's CARPA escrow sub-accounts.
positive.prompt: List our CARPA escrow sub-accounts and their available balances in ATLAS Legal.

positive.description: List time entries and legal diligences
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_diligences and returns the recorded legal diligences, durations in minutes, and fee amounts.
positive.prompt: Show the recent legal diligences and time entries recorded in ATLAS Legal.

interface.longDescription: Connect your ATLAS Legal law firm workspace (www.atlas-legal.lu) to inspect active legal matters (dossiers), individual and corporate clients, procedural deadlines and court hearings, recorded diligences and time entries, fee invoices, judicial expertises (Opalexe / Net-Expert), CARPA escrow sub-accounts, and SHA-256 sealed document metadata under strict tenant isolation.
defaultPrompt: Summarize our law firm's active dossiers and upcoming procedural deadlines in ATLAS Legal.
List all active dossiers and their LCB-FT compliance status in ATLAS Legal.
Show our CARPA sub-accounts and recent fee invoices in ATLAS Legal.

publication.release_notes: Release 1.0.0: Initial public release of ATLAS Legal MCP connector with 12 read-only tools for law firm practice management (get_cabinet_summary, list_dossiers, get_dossier_details, list_clients, list_deadlines, list_diligences, list_bills, list_judicial_expertises, list_carpa_accounts, list_documents, search, fetch) and OAuth 2.1 + PKCE + CIMD authentication.

fr-FR.subtitle: Gestion de cabinet d'avocats
fr-FR.description: Connectez votre espace ATLAS Legal (www.atlas-legal.lu) pour consulter vos dossiers contentieux et conseil, vos clients, votre calendrier procédural, vos diligences, vos factures d'honoraires, vos expertises judiciaires (Opalexe) et vos sous-comptes CARPA en lecture seule.
